# MonkeyMan

> MonkeyMan is an Oakland-based DJ and selector rooted in house, funk, and soul. Tagline: "No Requests." Available for bookings across the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond.

## About

MonkeyMan (also known as DJ MonkeyMan, @djmonkey_man, and itsdjmonkeyman) is a Bay Area DJ based in Oakland, California. His sound is rooted in house, funk, and soul — with a deep library of disco and classics. His tagline is "No Requests." From dusty vinyl crates to packed dance floors, his focus is always the groove.

A regular on the Bay Area circuit, MonkeyMan has performed at venues including The Great Northern, Monarch, Ruby Room, The Valencia Room, Thee Stork Club, Decodance, Phonobar, Club Waziema, Arcana, Days Like This, Compact Disco, Monterey Pride, Kilowatt, MHAH Gallery, Paris 75, Oakland Art Library, Asiento, Free*Party, High 5 Rooftop Bar, and Town Bar & Lounge. He has been featured on Fault Radio San Francisco and appeared as a guest on La Casa Discoteca Radio Show. He has shared the decks with acts including Young Franco, Kenny Summit, Jayvi Velasco, Lady Ryan, and Cherry Pie.

## Genres

House, Funk, Soul, Disco, Underground House, Classic House, Deep House, Boogie, Classics. Tagline: "No Requests."
